worldcombat.skill.imprison.summary: Locks every move you know into a seal and spreads it into a domain; any foe inside that shares a move with you is turned back from using it. Switch to a move outside the list, leave the domain, or break the caster's seal to be freed.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.use.0: Shut down a whole band of moves you and the foe share
worldcombat.skill.imprison.use.1: Pin a mirror or same-species foe that knows your moves
worldcombat.skill.imprison.use.2: Force a foe off the few moves it relies on
worldcombat.skill.imprison.description.0: The seal stays on the caster for %1$s: every move you know is locked into the domain for that time.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.description.1: The domain reaches %1$s blocks and the seal is cut with %2$s runes; every foe inside that shares a move with you gets branded.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.description.2: Raising the seal takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. The domain moves with you; foes who leave it or stop sharing a move are released.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.scope.0: Deep: domain x0.8, duration x1.35, cooldown x1.15 — hold one patch longer.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.scope.1: Wide: domain x1.25, duration x0.75, cooldown x0.9 — cover more ground for less time.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.timing: Cast on yourself: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s, the cooldown %5$s from commit, and the current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.preference.sc: Deep: domain x0.8, duration x1.35, cooldown x1.15. Wide: domain x1.25, duration x0.75, cooldown x0.9. Trade the size of the domain for how long it holds.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.preference.ai: The partner only considers the seal while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger raises it for foes further out.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to raise the seal.
